contexts.text: Joktan = the external worship of the Second Ancient Church.

By the two sons of Eber are signified the two worships, internal and external, which two sons were called Peleg, and Joktan; and by Peleg is signified the internal worship of that Church, and by Joktan the external worship of that Church. Explained. AC 1244. AC 1247.
The sons of Joktan = the things of external worship, which are rituals.
